question: For each tenant, report the number of ports that are both DOWN (using a running sum of STANDARD_ATTR_ID within each security group) and administratively up (including port security binding counts and total enabled port security), show the average of this count across all tenants as a benchmark, and categorize each tenant as 'HIGH_USER' (at least 50% above average), 'LOW_USER' (at least 50% below average), or 'AVERAGE_USER'. Do not return any rounded answers.

prediction.sql:
WITH down_admin_ports AS (
  SELECT p.id AS port_id,
         p.tenant_id,
         sgpb.security_group_id,
         p.standard_attr_id
  FROM ports p
  JOIN securitygroupportbindings sgpb ON sgpb.port_id = p.id
  WHERE p.status = 'DOWN'
    AND p.admin_state_up = 1
),
port_security AS (
  SELECT p.id AS port_id,
         COUNT(psb.port_id) AS port_security_binding_count,
         COALESCE(SUM(psb.port_security_enabled), 0) AS total_enabled_port_security
  FROM ports p
  LEFT JOIN portsecuritybindings psb ON psb.port_id = p.id
  GROUP BY p.id
),
running_sums AS (
  SELECT dap.port_id,
         dap.tenant_id,
         SUM(dap.standard_attr_id) OVER (
           PARTITION BY dap.security_group_id
           ORDER BY dap.standard_attr_id
         ) AS running_sum
  FROM down_admin_ports dap
),
qualifying_ports AS (
  SELECT rs.port_id,
         rs.tenant_id
  FROM running_sums rs
  JOIN port_security ps ON ps.port_id = rs.port_id
  WHERE ps.port_security_binding_count > 0
    AND ps.total_enabled_port_security > 0
),
tenant_counts AS (
  SELECT tenant_id,
         COUNT(*) AS port_count
  FROM qualifying_ports
  GROUP BY tenant_id
),
avg_benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(port_count) AS avg_port_count
  FROM tenant_counts
)
SELECT tc.tenant_id,
       tc.port_count,
       ab.avg_port_count AS benchmark,
       CASE 
         WHEN tc.port_count >= ab.avg_port_count * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_USER'
         WHEN tc.port_count <= ab.avg_port_count * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_USER'
         ELSE 'AVERAGE_USER'
       END AS user_category
FROM tenant_counts tc
CROSS JOIN avg_benchmark ab
ORDER BY tc.tenant_id;

WITH down_admin_ports AS (
  SELECT p.id AS port_id,
         p.tenant_id,
         sgpb.security_group_id,
         p.standard_attr_id
  FROM ports p
  JOIN securitygroupportbindings sgpb ON sgpb.port_id = p.id
  WHERE p.status = 'DOWN'
    AND p.admin_state_up = 1
),
port_security AS (
  SELECT p.id AS port_id,
         COUNT(psb.port_id) AS port_security_binding_count,
         COALESCE(SUM(psb.port_security_enabled), 0) AS total_enabled_port_security
  FROM ports p
  LEFT JOIN portsecuritybindings psb ON psb.port_id = p.id
  GROUP BY p.id
),
running_sums AS (
  SELECT dap.port_id,
         dap.tenant_id,
         SUM(dap.standard_attr_id) OVER (
           PARTITION BY dap.security_group_id
           ORDER BY dap.standard_attr_id
         ) AS running_sum
  FROM down_admin_ports dap
),
qualifying_ports AS (
  SELECT rs.port_id,
         rs.tenant_id
  FROM running_sums rs
  JOIN port_security ps ON ps.port_id = rs.port_id
  WHERE ps.port_security_binding_count > 0
    AND ps.total_enabled_port_security > 0
),
tenant_counts AS (
  SELECT tenant_id,
         COUNT(*) AS port_count
  FROM qualifying_ports
  GROUP BY tenant_id
),
avg_benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(port_count) AS avg_port_count
  FROM tenant_counts
)
SELECT tc.tenant_id,
       tc.port_count,
       ab.avg_port_count AS benchmark,
       CASE 
         WHEN tc.port_count >= ab.avg_port_count * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_USER'
         WHEN tc.port_count <= ab.avg_port_count * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_USER'
         ELSE 'AVERAGE_USER'
       END AS user_category
FROM tenant_counts tc
CROSS JOIN avg_benchmark ab
ORDER BY tc.tenant_id;

WITH base AS (
  SELECT p.tenant_id,
         p.id AS port_id,
         SUM(p.standard_attr_id) OVER (PARTITION BY b.security_group_id ORDER BY p.standard_attr_id) AS running_sum,
         (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM portsecuritybindings psb WHERE psb.port_id = p.id) AS psb_count,
         (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(psb2.port_security_enabled),0) FROM portsecuritybindings psb2 WHERE psb2.port_id = p.id) AS ps_enabled
  FROM ports p
  JOIN securitygroupportbindings b ON b.port_id = p.id
  WHERE p.status = 'DOWN' AND p.admin_state_up = 1
),
tenant_counts AS (
  SELECT tenant_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM base
  WHERE running_sum = (SELECT MAX(running_sum) FROM base b2 WHERE b2.tenant_id = base.tenant_id)
    AND psb_count > 0 AND ps_enabled > 0
  GROUP BY tenant_id
),
avg AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt FROM tenant_counts)
SELECT t.tenant_id,
       t.cnt,
       a.avg_cnt,
       CASE WHEN t.cnt >= a.avg_cnt * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_USER'
            WHEN t.cnt <= a.avg_cnt * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_USER'
            ELSE 'AVERAGE_USER' END AS category
FROM tenant_counts t CROSS JOIN avg a
ORDER BY t.tenant_id;

  SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id,
         COUNT(sgpb.security_group_id) AS sg_binding_count,

  FROM ports p
  JOIN securitygroupportbindings sgpb ON sgpb.port_id = p.id
  LEFT JOIN portsecuritybindings psb ON psb.port_id = p.id
  WHERE p.status = 'DOWN' AND p.admin_state_up = 1
  GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id
),
port_running AS (
  SELECT port_id, tenant_id, sg_binding_count, enabled_port_security,
         SUM(standard_attr_id) OVER (PARTITION BY tenant_id ORDER BY port_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_sum
  FROM (
    SELECT pb.port_id, pb.tenant_id, pb.sg_binding_count, pb.enabled_port_security, p.standard_attr_id
    FROM port_base pb JOIN ports p ON p.id = pb.port_id
  ) t
),
tenant_counts AS (

  FROM port_running
  GROUP BY tenant_id
),
